headline: Five scenarios now prove what VedaPath can answer, hold, refuse, and recover from.
copy: The runner uses the same registry and local API contract as the learner Ask room, so demo evidence cannot drift into a separate product story.

postures.title: Approved source
postures.copy: Oppenheimer resolves to Bhagavad Gita 11.32 with a category correction.

postures.title: Review source
postures.copy: Isha Upanishad remains visibly in review rather than silently promoted.

postures.title: Hold source
postures.copy: Gayatri context remains held for rights and reviewer work.

postures.title: No source
postures.copy: Bitcoin overclaim returns a transparent refusal packet.

postures.title: Offline API
postures.copy: The browser names the reviewed fallback instead of pretending the API responded.

flow.title: Prepare
flow.copy: Open the Ask demo in reviewed-preview mode.

flow.title: Prove
flow.copy: Run approved, review, hold, and no-source questions.

flow.title: Recover
flow.copy: Switch to local mode with the API offline and observe the named fallback.

flow.title: Close
flow.copy: State the storage, rights, authority, and launch locks before discussion.

decisions.label: Demo posture
decisions.reason: The scenario set is suitable for founder and reviewer learning only.

decisions.label: Evidence
decisions.reason: Registry and local API results are checked from one runner.

decisions.label: Observation
decisions.reason: Reviewer notes need an explicit session-only surface.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: A repeatable demo is not production authorization.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No model call or generated scripture is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable learner, reviewer, observation, or telemetry storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No translation text is published without recorded rights evidence.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The product remains study and reflection support, not a guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private-demo evidence does not authorize a public service.
